responsibility: Implements the analyzer checker for stdio stream objects represented by FILE *. This file defines a dedicated state_machine that tracks fopen-style acquisition, unchecked/null/non-null/closed stream states, state transitions driven by calls and null checks, leak handling, and FILE-specific pending_diagnostic subclasses for misuse reports such as double fclose and leaked streams; it also registers known-function models for selected stdio routines so the region model can approximate their return values and buffer-clobbering effects without fully analyzing libc internals.
